entries.question: Sunday ke roz report mil Sakta hai
entries.answer:
KGMU mein OPD, OT, aur administrative offices Sunday ko band rehte hain. Sunday ko report prapt karne ki suvidha uplabdh nahi hoti hai. Aap apni report lene ke liye Somwar (Monday) se Shaniwar (Saturday) ke beech aa sakte hain.

Emergency services 24/7 chalti hain, lekin routine reports ke liye aapko karyalayi samay (9:00 AM – 1:00 PM) mein hi aana hoga.

Main hoon KGMU AI CHATBOT, jise Dr. Ayush Yadav ne banaya hai.

entries.question: Scholarship kab bharna start hota hai
entries.answer:
Scholarship ke liye aavedan (application) ki prakriya aam taur par **National Scholarship Portal (NSP)** ke madhyam se hoti hai. 

Iske baare mein mahatvapurn jaankari niche di gayi hai:

1. **Official Website:** Aap regular updates ke liye [https://scholarships.gov.in/](https://scholarships.gov.in/) par check karte rahein.
2. **Kab shuru hota hai:** Scholarship ke aavedan aam taur par har saal **July se September/October** ke beech shuru hote hain. Yeh dates har saal sarkar dwara nirdharit ki jaati hain.
3. **KGMU Students ke liye:** Aap apne department ya university ke **Student Section/Dean Office** se bhi sampark kar sakte hain, kyunki kai baar state-level scholarships ya university-specific scholarships ki jaankari wahan ke notice board par di jaati hai.
4. **Zaroori Documents:** Aapko apne paas apna Aadhaar card, income certificate, caste certificate (yadi lagu ho), fee receipt, aur pichli kaksha ki mark sheet taiyaar rakhni chahiye.

Main aapko salah doonga ki aap samay-samay par [www.kgmu.org](http://www.kgmu.org) ke 'Notice Board' section ko dekhte rahein, jahan scholarship se sambandhit adhikarik soochnayein jaari ki jaati hain.

*I was created by Dr. Ayush Yadav.*

entries.question: What the ot open tomorrow
entries.answer:
Whether the Operation Theatre (OT) is open depends on whether tomorrow is a declared holiday.

*   **If tomorrow is a working day:** The Operation Theatre is functional for scheduled procedures and emergencies.
*   **If tomorrow is a General (Gazetted) Holiday:** Routine OTs are closed, and only emergency surgeries are performed.

Please refer to the **General (Gazetted) Holidays 2026** list provided in the previous message to check if tomorrow is listed. If you are a patient, please confirm your surgery schedule directly with your department or your treating surgeon. 

If this is an emergency, please proceed directly to the **Trauma Centre (Gate 14)**, which remains open 24/7 regardless of holidays.
